ext_desc.message: Highlights probable hate speech on the page you choose to scan. Runs fully on your device: no server, no data leaves the browser. A research tool that supports human judgment, it never blocks or removes anything.

cannot_scan.message: This page cannot be scanned (browser pages are protected).

disclaimer.message: Probabilities are a model representation, not a human verdict. The study behind this tool measures over-flagging of some identity terms. It supports review, it does not replace it.
